{"reason":"Adding (high-confidence? edi-change) as a fourth AND condition filters six of the eight cited false rows (confidence 0.44–0.67), directly targeting v1’s 20/28 false arbitrations (rate 0.714) while retaining the magnitude, exposure, and non-frozen criteria to protect recall.","source":"(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))
       (high-confidence? edi-change)))"}
